question: Should the digest-only receipt API and shared prepared-event semantics become the durable action-ledger contract in this stack, and in what landing order?
rationale: Tests can validate the implementation, but automation cannot decide whether the shared ledger contract should expand now or whether the stacked branches provide the intended permanent compatibility boundary.

options.title: Land in dependency order
options.body: Approve the shared contract, merge https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/550 and https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/554 first, retarget this PR to main, and require focused replay validation before https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/563 consumes it.

options.title: Narrow the shared change
options.body: Keep the receipt design but avoid changing the general record path until prepared-event compatibility is independently proven for existing producers.

options.title: Hold for consumer proof
options.body: Leave the stack in draft until a protected live cloud/parity run demonstrates that the receipt contract is necessary and sufficient for the intended consumer.

recommendation.title: Land in dependency order
recommendation.body: Approve the shared contract, merge https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/550 and https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/554 first, retarget this PR to main, and require focused replay validation before https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/563 consumes it.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the related Gitcrawl stack and authored the shared ledger changes, making them the best available person to present the intended contract and landing sequence for approval.
